# CineCub — Complete Specification (llms-full.txt)

> CineCub is a free, high-performance web streaming application designed for seamless playback of feature movies, multi-season television shows, and Japanese anime series in 1080p and 4K UHD. Built on Next.js 16, Cloudflare Workers, and Go microservices.

## 1. Platform Identity & Metadata
- **Platform Name**: CineCub
- **Canonical Domain**: https://cinecub.stream
- **Primary Purpose**: Web-based media discovery, streaming metadata index, and video player interface.
- **Licensing & Legal Status**: CineCub operates purely as an index of publicly available metadata and third-party media streams. CineCub does not store, upload, or host any copyrighted video files on its infrastructure. All video content is delivered via third-party distributed networks.
- **Legal Contact**: Users and copyright holders can submit DMCA takedown notices via the platform's embedded legal modal or direct communication.

## 2. Platform Taxonomy & URL Routes

### 2.1 Navigation Pages
- `https://cinecub.stream/`: Main homepage with curated spotlight hero banner, real-time trending titles, continue-watching row, and latest releases.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=movie`: Filterable movie catalog.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=tv`: Television series catalog with episode trees.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=anime`: Anime catalog covering seasonal broadcasts, OVAs, and films.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=trending`: Daily and weekly trending titles across cinema and TV.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=popular`: High-volume titles ranked by global view count.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=toprated`: Highest user-rated titles of all time.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=upcoming`: Upcoming theatrical and broadcast releases.
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=watchlist`: User-saved titles (requires authentication).
- `https://cinecub.stream/?page=history`: User playback history and progress tracking.

### 2.2 Search Query Format
- `https://cinecub.stream/?q={query}`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?q=Interstellar`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?q=Breaking+Bad`
  - Supports full titles, partial match, character names, and cast searches.

### 2.3 Direct Detail and Video Playback Deep Links
- **Movie Deep Link**:
  - Pattern: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail={tmdb_id}&type=movie`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail=27205&type=movie` (Inception)
- **TV Series Deep Link**:
  - Pattern: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail={tmdb_id}&type=tv`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail=1396&type=tv` (Breaking Bad)
- **Specific Season & Episode Playback**:
  - Pattern: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail={tmdb_id}&type=tv&season={s}&episode={e}`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail=1396&type=tv&season=5&episode=14` (Ozymandias)

## 3. Streaming Engine & Technical Specifications
- **Player Types**:
  - HLS (HTTP Live Streaming via `Hls.js`) for adaptive multi-resolution playback (360p up to 4K).
  - Native MP4 / MKV HTML5 `<video>` for direct, low-latency progressive playback.
  - Multi-server redundancy: If one server fails or throttles, the player automatically cascades to fallback providers.
- **Server Selection**:
  - Ad-free playback engine with proxy stream forwarding to prevent malicious popups, ad injections, and intrusive trackers.
- **Subtitles**: Multi-language subtitle tracks (.vtt / .srt) fetched from open subtitle repositories.
- **State Synchronization**:
  - Playback progress, resume timestamps, watchlist, and history saved locally via LocalStorage and synchronized to Cloudflare D1 upon user authentication.

## 4. Crawlability & Machine Interface Directives
- **Sitemap**: `https://cinecub.stream/sitemap.xml`
- **Robots Directives**: `https://cinecub.stream/robots.txt`
- **Schema.org Structured Data**: Complete JSON-LD graphs on all pages, including `WebSite` with `SearchAction`, `SiteNavigationElement`, `BreadcrumbList`, and `Movie` / `TVSeries` / `VideoObject` with `WatchAction` and `SeekToAction`.
- **AI Crawler Allowances**: Open access granted for `GPTBot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`, and `Applebot`.
